message:
cmake is now available. Let me build the HDF5 library. This will take a while, so let me run it in the background.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hdf5 && mkdir -p build-dir && cd build-dir && cmake -G "Unix Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING=Release -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS:BOOL=OFF -DBUILD_TESTING:BOOL=OFF -DHDF5_BUILD_EXAMPLES:BOOL=OFF -DHDF5_BUILD_TOOLS:BOOL=OFF -DHDF5_ENABLE_Z_LIB_SUPPORT:BOOL=ON .. > /tmp/cmake_build.log 2>&1 && make -j$(nproc) > /tmp/make_build.log 2>&1 &
echo "Build started PID $!"</｜｜DSML｜｜>
